notes: Measured on AE 2026 8 bpc. Luminance of the STRAIGHT 8-bit colour L = 0.30 R + 0.59 G + 0.11 B, unrounded (the only weights with zero misclassified pixels: Rec.601 .299/.587/.114 and Rec.709 misplace hundreds); transparent pixels count as black. Key Out Brighter (1): keyed when L > Threshold; Key Out Darker (2): keyed when L < Threshold; L == Threshold is kept (both measured, Darker bit-exact: 11976 pixels at exactly L = 100 kept). Tolerance does nothing for types 1/2 (measured: Tolerance 20 gives a hard key). Edge Feather: separable blur of the binary matte by three iterated fractional boxes of radii (0.494, 0.349, 0.194) x Feather (least-squares fit on the Feather 10 ref: max 1/255, 3 % of pixels off by 1; AE's Fast-Blur kernel 3 x 0.369 F gives max 3, a Gaussian / 2 boxes / 2D isotropic kernels max 3-28; the kernel has a flat top). The matte outside the layer is that of transparent black (kept for Key Out Brighter: the feather bleeds inwards at the layer edges, as AE does, measured). Output alpha = floor(alpha8 * matte) (AE truncates: complementary edge values sum to 254), straight colour kept, premultiplied (c8 * a + 127) div 255. Not covered by a visible ref (models): the linear scaling of the three radii with Feather (only Feather 10 seen), Key Out Similar (keyed when |L - Threshold| <= Tolerance) / Dissimilar (the complement), Edge Thin (> 0 erodes, < 0 dilates the matte by |n| px, square window, before the feather). Kernels wider than 255 taps are sampled every ceil(taps/255) px (approximation, Feather > ~120). 4 passes: matte + horizontal thin, vertical thin, horizontal blur (16-bit packed R/G), vertical blur + composite with origTex. AE 6 Compositing Options not reproduced. Rive residuals (max 1-2/255, mean <= 0.008 %) are the Rive canvas/composite +-1 noise already documented on tint/invert, not the shader.
